examples.title: One task across four live adapters
examples.title_zh: 四个真实适配器的同一任务
prerequisites: A user-owned exact execution profile and the selected host. Export and verify are offline.
prerequisites_zh: 用户自有、明确授权的 execution profile，以及所选宿主。导出与验证均离线。

examples.title: Editable native plugin and resource
examples.title_zh: 可修改的原生插件与资源
examples.execution_boundary: no model; runtime requires supported local process/IPC permissions
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ and installed rpnh-harness in the same environment.
Install the exported plugin with the explicit command below; exporting never installs or executes it.
Linux/POSIX runtime with the process and Unix-domain socket permissions required by the harness.
prerequisites_zh: Python 3.11+，且同一环境已安装 rpnh-harness。
按下方命令明确安装导出的插件；导出操作不会安装或执行代码。
运行需 Linux/POSIX 与 harness 所需的进程及 Unix-domain socket 权限。
commands: rpnh plugins --config examples/native_plugin/plugins.json run demo/add --input examples/native_plugin/input.json --run-dir /absolute/absent/add-run

examples.title: Editable model/program/model workflow
examples.title_zh: 可修改的模型/程序/模型工作流
examples.execution_boundary: scripted local fixture by default; real provider only with explicit --execution
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ and installed rpnh-harness in the same environment.
Install the included native_plugin; keep examples/_support and native_plugin beside hybrid_summary.
Scripted runs still need supported local process/IPC permissions. A live profile is optional and separately authorized.
prerequisites_zh: Python 3.11+，且同一环境已安装 rpnh-harness。
安装随附 native_plugin；保留 hybrid_summary 同级的 examples/_support 和 native_plugin。
脚本化运行仍需本地进程/IPC 权限；真实 profile 为额外授权的可选项。

examples.title: Two-stage definition composition only
examples.title_zh: 仅定义层的两阶段组合
examples.execution_boundary: definition only; no Registry run, executor registration or model call
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ and installed rpnh-harness.
This prints a ModuleDeclaration. Running it as a task additionally requires matching trusted executor, component, terminal and schema registrations; none are installed by this export.
prerequisites_zh: 本例只输出 ModuleDeclaration；执行为任务还需匹配的受信 executor/component/terminal/schema 注册，本次导出不会安装这些注册。

examples.title: Reusable v2 package and trusted native profile
examples.title_zh: 可复用 v2 包与受信原生 profile
examples.execution_boundary: data-only package authoring and resolution; execution is a separate explicit step
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ and installed rpnh-harness.
Follow the included guide to build/install the trusted native plugin and prepare a v2 package.
Preview and resolve do not execute package code. Runtime needs supported process/IPC permissions.
prerequisites_zh: 按随附指南构建/安装受信原生插件并准备 v2 包。
preview 与 resolve 不执行包代码；运行仍需支持的进程/IPC 权限。

examples.title: Serial, parallel, document and long-process gallery
examples.execution_boundary: scripted by default; optional live profile
prerequisites: Source checkout plus examples/_support; read its guide before choosing a scenario.

examples.title: Independent task workspaces
prerequisites: Source checkout plus examples/_support and supported local process/IPC permissions.

examples.title: Live net replacement
prerequisites: Source checkout and separately authorized exact execution profile. compose_serial is the separately exportable definition-only subset.

examples.title: Clinical document/data research packet
prerequisites: Linux/WSL2, source checkout, installed RPNH and a separately authorized exact execution profile.
Obtain the official article/supplements listed in sources.json; those files and participant rows are not redistributed here.
Preparation embeds participant-level workbook text in the prompt. Review source/privacy terms and explicitly acknowledge that data transfer before any provider-backed run.

examples.title: Numerical optimal-control research example
prerequisites: Linux/WSL2, source checkout, installed RPNH and a separately authorized exact execution profile.
The selected workspace must provide numerical packages used by the task (NumPy/SciPy is the documented common path); read sources.json and the source guide.

examples.title: HarnessAudit Office benchmark
examples.execution_boundary: retained results offline; new runs require authorized profiles
prerequisites: Linux/WSL2, Python 3.11+, source checkout and separately installed examples/harnessaudit_office dependencies (PyYAML, jsonschema).
Separately install UCSB-AI/HarnessAudit pinned at 6317162590aeeb1c8dde32b880ac199933343e4a with its oai extra; read source-pins.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
Retained results need no provider. New runs/scoring require the setup in the source guide and explicitly authorized local profiles.

examples.title: RRSI v0.6 application
prerequisites: Python 3.11+, source checkout and separately installed examples/rrsi_v06 package/test dependencies.
Read THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and the protocol; new provider-backed rounds and independent child runs require a user-owned, explicitly authorized exact execution profile.

examples.title: AutomationBench benchmark and extensions
examples.execution_boundary: retained results offline; new live runs need authorization
prerequisites: Python 3.13+ in an independent environment (core RPNH only requires Python 3.11+).
A source checkout plus separately installed zapier/AutomationBench pinned at 4a8e1061254004d9dac807054eed33fad7d1ff14 (1.0.6); follow its README/RUNBOOK and license terms.
A user-owned, separately authorized exact execution profile for new live runs. Retained results are readable offline; benchmark execution dependencies are not exported.
